investigated_claim: VALIDATION.md pinned triage baseline 0/113 with 113 invalid outputs reads as a baseline failure
root_cause: All 113 saved baseline records carry "parsed": null because the unadapted base model (unsloth/Qwen3.5-0.8B, no LoRA adapter) emitted free-text prose, not structured JSON, under the study's declared decoding (greedy do_sample=false, max_new_tokens=192, malformed_json_repair=false). The workbench replays saved declarations and counts invalid outputs in the denominator by design; the 0/113 row exactly reproduces the study's own negative control.
